HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   C. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

5. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.

   A. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
